Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and two concrete asks so we can line up the technical deep-dive: 

Summary (quick):
- NewSky is evaluating a partner-led marketplace integration for our managed services customers. Main priorities: predictable latency targets, per-tenant data isolation, and an easy deployment story for our channel customers.
- We want to validate Redwood’s Dedicated and private deployment options and confirm how model variants + fallback would look under our SLOs.

Asks / next steps: 
1) Please review the attached Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — I dropped in what we think stage gates look like and ownership. Mark edits inline.
2) Can we schedule the technical deep-dive (60–75 minutes) the week of Oct 25? Ideal attendees: Redwood solutions architect, partner eng lead, and our platform lead. I pasted our availability below.

Our availability (NewSky):
- Tue 10/27: 9:00–11:30 PT
- Wed 10/28: 13:00–16:00 PT
- Thu 10/29: 9:00–12:00 PT

I attached a draft MAP and added a brief list of goals for the deep-dive. If you can share an availability grid on your side, we’ll lock a time and I’ll send the calendar invite + tentative agenda.

Attachments: NSG_mutual_action_plan_draft.pdf

Thanks — Lina
